en: A sepia-toned view of a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a calm river, with its arches and the buildings beyond reflected clearly in the water. On the far bank stands a large, plain, multi‑storey industrial-looking building (possibly a mill or factory) and a smaller residential or administrative house to the right. Trees line the background. The image has wide margins like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No printed text is visible on the image side.
